title: Exactness of the upper fraction sequence
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module], F any O_X-module, and s a global section of L. Write H^p(W,G) for open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], and C^p(W) for CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p W [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation], with generator [n,xi]. Suppose delta(A,B,p):H^p(A intersect B,-) -> H^(p+1)(A union B,-) is a natural transformation in the module for every pair of opens and p. Assume the degree-zero restriction pair is injective for every module, and the restriction-pair, difference-of-restrictions, and delta maps give the three exact positions of a Mayer--Vietoris sequence for every module and p. For any U,V there are additive maps a:C^p(U union V) -> C^p(U) times C^p(V), b:C^p(U) times C^p(V) -> C^p(U intersect V), and d:C^p(U intersect V) -> C^(p+1)(U union V), for all p. Their values on generators are respectively the pair of restrictions, the positive U restriction, the negative V restriction, and delta applied to the numerator. The map a in degree zero is injective, and all triples (a_p,b_p), (b_p,d_p), (d_p,a_(p+1)) are exact. This statement has no comparison maps and no nonvanishing open.

proof.text: Construct the additive inclusion of each numerator group into its direct sum quotient. A natural transformation of open module cohomology commutes with tensor-section multiplication by naturality. Extend its numerator maps using DirectSum.toAddMonoid; every generating fraction relation maps to zero by that naturality and the defining quotient relation. Descend with QuotientAddGroup.lift. Take the product of the two restriction maps for a, the difference of the intersection restriction maps composed with projections for b, and the descended delta for d. Their four prescribed formulas follow by evaluation on direct-sum generators and additivity.

The quotient relations directly identify [n,xi] with [n+b,s^b xi]. Quotient induction and DirectSum.induction_on show that every fraction is represented by one numerator: for a sum of representatives in degrees n,m move both to n+m and add their numerators. The same padding gives a common denominator for a pair of fractions over different opens. A zero numerator class is killed by a later transition by the proved eventual-zero criterion.

For exactness at the product term, choose a common denominator, apply the eventual-zero criterion to the difference of the restricted numerators, and use naturality to move the original pair to that denominator. The assumed first exactness supplies its preimage. For exactness at the intersection term, kill the delta numerator, move the original numerator by naturality, and apply the assumed second exactness. At the union term, successively kill the U and V restrictions; naturality preserves the already-zero U restriction. The assumed third exactness supplies a delta preimage. These numerator preimages yield fraction preimages by the generator formulas and transition relation. Conversely the assumed composites vanish on numerators, hence on all fractions by single-numerator representations. To prove injectivity of a at degree zero, kill both restrictions successively, use the assumed degree-zero injectivity against the zero numerator, and conclude that the original fraction is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cohomologyFraction_mayerVietoris_exact (X : Scheme.{uMV})
    (L F : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (U V : X.Opens) (δ : ∀ (A B : X.Opens) (p : ℕ),
      openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (A ⊓ B) ⟶
        openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + 1) (A ⊔ B))
    (_hinj :
      (∀ (A B : X.Opens) (G : X.Modules),
        Function.Injective
          (fun x : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 0 (A ⊔ B)).obj G =>
            ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace 0
                (homOfLE (le_sup_left : A ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x,
              (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace 0
                (homOfLE (le_sup_right : B ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x))))
    (_hexact :
      (∀ (A B : X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (p : ℕ),
        Function.Exact
          (fun x : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (A ⊔ B)).obj G =>
            ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (le_sup_left : A ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x,
              (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (le_sup_right : B ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x))
          (fun x : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p A).obj G ×
              (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p B).obj G =>
            (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A))).app G x.1 -
              (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (inf_le_right : A ⊓ B ≤ B))).app G x.2) ∧
        Function.Exact
          (fun x : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p A).obj G ×
              (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p B).obj G =>
            (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A))).app G x.1 -
              (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
                (homOfLE (inf_le_right : A ⊓ B ≤ B))).app G x.2)
          ((δ A B p).app G) ∧
        Function.Exact ((δ A B p).app G)
          (fun x : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + 1) (A ⊔ B)).obj G =>
            ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace (p + 1)
                (homOfLE (le_sup_left : A ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x,
              (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace (p + 1)
                (homOfLE (le_sup_right : B ≤ A ⊔ B))).app G x)))) :
    ∃ (a : ∀ p : ℕ, CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p (U ⊔ V) →+
        CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p U × CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p V)
      (b : ∀ p : ℕ,
        CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p U × CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p V →+
          CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p (U ⊓ V))
      (d : ∀ p : ℕ, CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p (U ⊓ V) →+
        CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s (p + 1) (U ⊔ V)),
      (∀ (p n : ℕ) (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊔ V)).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        a p (cohomologyFraction L F s p (U ⊔ V) n ξ) =
          (cohomologyFraction L F s p U n
            ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
              (homOfLE le_sup_left)).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ),
          cohomologyFraction L F s p V n
            ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
              (homOfLE le_sup_right)).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ))) ∧
      (∀ (p n : ℕ)
        (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p U).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        b p (cohomologyFraction L F s p U n ξ, 0) = cohomologyFraction L F s p (U ⊓ V) n
          ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE inf_le_left)).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)) ∧
      (∀ (p n : ℕ)
        (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p V).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        b p (0, cohomologyFraction L F s p V n ξ) = -cohomologyFraction L F s p (U ⊓ V) n
          ((openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE inf_le_right)).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)) ∧
      (∀ (p n : ℕ) (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ V)).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        d p (cohomologyFraction L F s p (U ⊓ V) n ξ) =
          cohomologyFraction L F s (p + 1) (U ⊔ V) n
            ((δ U V p).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)) ∧
      Function.Injective (a 0) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Function.Exact (a p) (b p) ∧ Function.Exact (b p) (d p) ∧
        Function.Exact (d p) (a (p + 1)))
